e.title: Patient-Level Risk Scoring (Databricks HLS)
e.summary: 患者级风险评分官方加速器（Databricks HLS，8★）：基于病史/病症历史构建患者风险评分
e.body: hls-patient-risk（databricks-industry-solutions，8★）是 Databricks Healthcare & Life Sciences 官方 Solution Accelerator：基于患者病症历史（condition history）做患者级风险评分——用结构化病史特征与 ML 给每位患者输出风险分。对 RIAA：健康险语境的风险评分参考——成员层面风险分层（承保、管理式医疗、Medicare 风险调整的互补视角）；与 [[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]]（HCC 提取）同为 HLS 官方加速器家族，延伸 [[databricks-jsl-medical]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Databricks HLS 官方患者级风险评分加速器（8★），基于病症历史
e.summary_en: Official Databricks HLS Solution Accelerator (8★): patient-level risk scoring from condition history
e.summary_hk: 患者級風險評分官方加速器（Databricks HLS，8★）：基於病史/病症歷史構建患者風險評分
e.body_en: hls-patient-risk (databricks-industry-solutions, 8★) is an official Databricks Healthcare & Life Sciences Solution Accelerator: patient-level risk scoring from condition history — structured-history features with ML produce a risk score per patient. For RIAA: a risk-scoring reference in the health-insurance context — member-level risk stratification (underwriting, managed care, a complementary view to Medicare risk adjustment); in the same HLS accelerator family as [[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]] (HCC extraction) and [[databricks-jsl-medical]].
e.body_hk: hls-patient-risk（databricks-industry-solutions，8★）是 Databricks Healthcare & Life Sciences 官方 Solution Accelerator：基於患者病症歷史（condition history）做患者級風險評分——用結構化病史特徵與 ML 給每位患者輸出風險分。對 RIAA：健康險語境的風險評分參考——成員層面風險分層（核保、管理式醫療、Medicare 風險調整的互補視角）；與 [[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]]（HCC 提取）同為 HLS 官方加速器家族，延伸 [[databricks-jsl-medical]]。
